title: Distinct Bags of Beads
statement:
You have `n` beads, and bead `i` has the number `a_i` on it. Beads with the same number look identical. Pick a bag of beads (at least one) whose numbers add up to exactly `S`. Two bags are the same when they contain the same count of beads for every number. Count the different bags.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `S`. The second line contains `a_1 ... a_n`.

## Output
Print the number of different bags with total exactly `S`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 18`
- `1 <= a_i <= 20`
- `1 <= S <= 360`
